decision.comment: HH_260906 - Freeze the small real-training profiling diagnostic before transfer or execution.
decision.data: Use the unchanged legacy v3 development corpus with known warmup and infeasible-target limitations. Explicitly denied later captures remain excluded. Full-corpus validation may read held-out test metadata/JPEG bytes, but no test neural-network inference, loss, metric or model selection is allowed.
decision.launch: Main operator may dispatch only after all eighteen STOPMIX stages and six separate behavior passes finish, then the existing cooperative GPU0 lease and idle checks pass. Use the personal py312 interpreter and an external 360-second timeout. Do not install, access GPU1, stop foreign processes or modify the repository to execute the external worker.
decision.limitations: Fixed A-then-B order, startup/caching and profiler overhead prevent a statistically fair throughput A/B claim. Inclusive operator times overlap; summed self time is not whole-wall GPU utilization. Trace paths remain private pending publication review.
decision.outcome: The small new checkpoints are diagnostic research artifacts only: no data admission, automatic model promotion, CARLA/vehicle actuation or runtime export. Preserve partial failures and source/input evidence.
decision.purpose: Measure operator and CUDA-kernel costs inside the unchanged trainer; do not alter checks, dataloader workers, model, loss, dataset, or runtime approval.
decision.schedule: Fresh A unprofiled then fresh B CPU/CUDA profiled. Both use the complete 1147-example train split, fixed seed, original physical model, sixteen optimizer updates and sixty-four sample exposures. Retain all sixteen metric rows in each arm; do not drop initialization or early steps.
decision.tensor_parity: Weights-only read the two final checkpoints on CPU and compare every structured field and tensor byte, including optimizer/RNG/runtime/device ABI; ignore only the top-level creation timestamp. Compare all thirty-two retained metric rows in paired order. Any mismatch fails the diagnostic.
decision.timing: The full train_model context includes decoding, initialization, actual forward/backward, checks, metrics and checkpoint writes. Full-corpus validation is measured separately before and after. Profile only the B context, with CPU and CUDA activities and no shapes, stacks, memory, FLOP or module recording.

remote_workspace_convention: W = the existing personal portable_e2e workspace; no account-specific path is published.
